name: Yibin Bank
summary: Yibin City Commercial Bank Co., Ltd., founded in 2006 and headquartered in Yibin, provides banking and financial services to individuals, companies and small and medium-sized enterprises in China through corporate banking, retail banking and financial markets. Its offerings include deposits, cards, bill discounting, guarantees, fund custody, settlement, mobile payments, insurance and wealth management, and loans for corporate, mortgage and consumption purposes.
